question: An administrator at a company that recently upgraded to a newer version of ServiceNow notices that the Service Portal Catalog landing page is missing. Which action must the administrator perform to enable this functionality?

choices.text: Navigate to the Service Portal configuration and enable 'Catalog Landing' in the portal record.
Activate the Service Portal - Service Catalog v2 plugin (com.glideapp.servicecatalog.portal).
Update the 'My Request Filter' module to point to the new catalog landing page.
Assign the 'catalog_admin' role to the users who need to access the landing page.

explanation: According to the documentation, upgrade users must specifically activate the 'Service Portal - Service Catalog v2' plugin (com.glideapp.servicecatalog.portal) to access the Catalog landing page, as it is only available by default for zBoot users.
pieges: Assuming the page is enabled by default for all users.
Confusing plugin activation with user role assignment or portal record configuration.
